In [[138 ABY]], [[Imperial Knight]] [[Jao Assam]] flew a '''class of starfighter''' that was affiliated with the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]]. The [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] sported two angular, horizontal wings, as well as two rear [[S-foils/Legends|S-foils]] that were vertical but that sat horizontally when the fighter was at rest. Gray in [[Color/Legends|color]], the fighter was also crewed by an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in an [[Astromech socket/Legends|astromech socket]]; Assam's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] of choice was named [[W3]].<ref name="Legacy 3" />

Assam had the fighter<ref name="Legacy 3" /> at a [[Ithori system secondary communications array outpost|secondary communications array outpost]] in the [[Ithori system/Legends|Ithori system]],<ref name="Legacy 2">[[Legacy (2013) 2|''Legacy'' (2013) 2]]</ref> before he took it to the [[Carreras system/Legends|Carreras system]] in search of the missing Imperial Knight [[Yalta Val]]. When he arrived on a [[Shifalan patrol ship]], he was arrested by the [[Shifala]]n guards, who were under orders from [[Darth Wredd]]&mdash;a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] posing as Val. Assam escaped in his fighter and dodged pursuit from [[Carreras starfighter]]s before landing on [[Carreras Minor]]. There, he joined a party consisting of the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Ania Solo]], the [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Sauk]], and the [[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[AG-37]], and loaded his fighter into [[AG-37's freighter]]. The group possessed an [[Unidentified Imperial communications droid|Imperial communications droid]] that possessed coordinates to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mala (planet)|Mala]], where Val was being held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by Wredd.<ref name="Legacy 3" />

When the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was captured by the Shifalan patrol [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and taken to the [[Carreras G51 communications array]], Assam's fighter was stored in a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]].<ref name="Legacy 4">[[Legacy (2013) 4|''Legacy'' (2013) 4]]</ref> [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Wredd [[Carreras Incident|battled]] and severely injured Sauk, AG-37, and Assam before taking a Carreras fighter to Mala, but Solo followed him in Assam's fighter and freed the [[Prisoner/Legends|captive]] Val. She then returned to the communications array, which was crashing into Mala, bringing Assam's fighter to a skidding crash-landing in the hangar. Solo brought her injured friends aboard AG-37's freighter and made an escape.<ref name="Legacy 5">[[Legacy (2013) 5|''Legacy'' (2013) 5]]</ref> Assam later experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] of the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his [[Empress/Legends|Empress]], [[Marasiah Fel]], that included several of the Triumvirate starfighters and [[Predator-class fighter|TIE Predators]].<ref name="Legacy 6">[[Legacy (2013) 6|''Legacy'' (2013) 6]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A fleet of these starfighters appears on the [[:File:Legacyphantom.jpg|phantom variant cover]] of [[Legacy (2013) 1|''Legacy'' (2013) 1]] as an homage to the [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing fighters]] on [[:File:Star Wars Style A poster 1977.jpg|the original poster]] of [[1977]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|Star Wars]].
